.codex/config.toml.content:
[mcp_servers.repowise]
command = "repowise"
args = ["mcp"]
cwd = "{REPO}"
required = true
startup_timeout_sec = 60
env_vars = ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL", "EDENAI_API_KEY", "EDENAI_BASE_URL", "GEMINI_API_KEY", "GEMINI_BASE_URL", "GOOGLE_API_KEY", "KIMI_API_KEY", "KIMI_BASE_URL", "LITELLM_API_BASE", "LITELLM_API_KEY", "LITELLM_BASE_URL", "OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIMS", "OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "OPENAI_BASE_URL", "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", "REPOWISE_CONFIG_DIR", "REPOWISE_DATABASE_URL", "REPOWISE_DB_URL", "REPOWISE_DOC_MODEL", "REPOWISE_EMBEDDER", "REPOWISE_EMBEDDING_DECLARED_DIMS", "REPOWISE_EMBEDDING_DIMS", "REPOWISE_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "REPOWISE_MODEL", "REPOWISE_POSTGRES_KEEPALIVE", "REPOWISE_PROVIDER", "REPOWISE_REASONING"]

[features]
hooks = true

.github/copilot-instructions.md.content:
<!-- REPOWISE_DISTILL:START — Do not edit below this line. Auto-generated by Repowise. -->
For any question about how, where or why this codebase works, or which files a task involves, you MUST call a Repowise MCP tool first (get_answer for how/where/why questions, search_codebase for an identifier, get_context for callers or a file) before Grep, find or reading files, and pass this rule on in any subagent brief. Use what it returns: open a cited file only for lines it did not show, and skip Grep when it marks a list complete. To edit a file you already know, go straight to it.

### Output Distillation

- Prefer `repowise distill <cmd>` for noisy commands: test runs, builds, `git status`/`log`/`diff`, searches, file listings. It runs the command unchanged (exit code preserved) and prints a compact, errors-first rendering; every error line survives.
- Output may contain a marker like `[repowise#a1b2c3d4e5f6: 230 lines omitted (~6.1k tokens); restore: repowise expand a1b2c3d4e5f6]`. The omitted content is fully preserved: run `repowise expand <ref>` to retrieve it, or `repowise expand <ref> -q <regex>` for just the matching lines.
- Never re-run a command to see omitted output; expand the marker instead.
- For structure-level questions about a large indexed file ("what's in here", "which function handles X"), `get_context(["path"], include=["skeleton"])` returns the file with bodies elided (every signature plus the bodies of the most central symbols) at a fraction of the cost of a full Read.
<!-- REPOWISE_DISTILL:END -->
